key_insight: Adaptive measurements and differentiable circuit search offer complementary QRL gains, but combining them can hurt tasks that benefit most from circuit search.
engineering_relevance: Choose ANO or DiffQAS according to whether measurement basis or gate topology limits performance, rather than enabling both by default.
method: Integrate Adaptive Non-local Observables (ANO) and Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search (DiffQAS) into QTSTransformer.
Use a 2 × 2 factorial ablation to test each innovation alone and together.
Evaluate on two classic-control tasks and four Atari 2600 games against a matched classical transformer.
evidence_signal: The quantum agent outperformed the classical baseline on five of six environments, including Breakout (17.2 vs 2.5), while using approximately 12.5× fewer transformer parameters on Atari.
watch_item: Lower transformer parameter counts do not establish runtime or hardware quantum advantage; the abstract does not report execution costs or noise robustness.
paper_title: Advancing Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search and Adaptive Non-local Observables
